title: Gurudev Hoysala
desc: Gurudev Hoysala, a morally upright police inspector, is transferred to Athani to investigate a fellow officer's disappearance. However, a suspicious young couple soon complicates the case.

title: Saamy 2
desc: Ramaswamy, who works as a front-end receptionist for Union Minister Viswanathan, decides to pursue civil service. Soon, Viswanathan's daughter falls in love with him after he saves her from gangsters.

title: Mr. Bachchan
desc: Suspended for his honesty, an income tax officer returns to his hometown to live with his family. However, he is soon reinstated and tasked with raiding the home of a corrupt politician.

title: Lucky Bhaskar
desc: A struggling bank teller takes a chance on a shady investment scheme with an unproven partner. Later, as his fortunes rise, so does his ego, driving him to take on increasingly reckless risks.

title: Touch Chesi Chudu
desc: Karthikeya, a man who is devoted to his family, faces a huge challenge as his violent and turbulent past begins to resurface.

title: Solo
desc: Gautam, an orphan, wishes to marry a woman from a joint family and his dream comes true when he falls in love with Vaishnavi. However, Vaishnavi's father is against their marriage.

title: Allari Bullodu
desc: When a wealthy businessman meets with an accident, his daughter takes over his company. Trisha's skills are tested when she has to spot the imposter, who is out to destroy her father's company.

title: Addiction Killer
desc: The host presents a wide range of Ayurvedic remedies for addiction that can be purchased from the comfort of one's home.

title: Kanche
desc: Hari and Eeshwar are two soldiers fighting the Nazi forces during World War II. Hari has to sacrifice his love and life to make a mistrustful Eeshwar understand some facts about living in harmony.

title: Manyam Puli
desc: A small village seeks help from a man with extraordinary force to protect them against man-eating tigers and the drug mafia.

title: Baahubali: The Beginning
desc: Raised by a tribe, a young man sets out to help his lady love rescue an enslaved princess of a kingdom that is ruled by a tyrannical king. In doing so, he soon discovers his true identity.

title: Teddy
desc: Srividya, a young woman, is put in a coma by corrupt doctors. However, her spirit enters a teddy bear and seeks out a lonely man named Shiva to uncover medical crimes.

title: SALAAR PART 1
desc: The future of a fiercely disputed nation hinges on the strained dynamics between Deva and Vardha Raja, two allies-turned-enemies.

title: Pokiri
desc: Krishna, a police officer, disguises himself as a thug and joins the mafia in order to wipe out the underworld. Meanwhile, he falls in love with Shruti, an aerobics teacher.
